text:
samantha: Quick preflight check — SOC2 fieldwork window starts Tue 09:00 PST. Need short acks on three things before Monday EOD: 1) audit-log sampling/export ready, 2) HSM attestation slot confirmed with vendor, 3) staging keystore rotation proof. Owners please ack and call blockers.

marta: Ack. Audit export PR is merged to staging, scheduled nightly. Can run ad-hoc export if needed. Command I use: 
```bash
./scripts/export_logs.sh --since=2024-03-01 --until=2024-03-07 --out=/tmp/audit_sample.tar.gz
```
I'll run a smoke Tue 08:00 PST and attach results. :thumbsup:

kevin: Heads up — staging keystore rotation hasn't run yet; CI shows missing staging KMS creds. I'll ping infra.

infra: Got it. Opened ticket INC-421 (infra) to provision temporary staging KMS creds and rotate after smoke. ETA to apply secret: 45m.

jules: Vendor confirms attestation slot Thu 11:00 UTC. They want a Redwood engineer present for the key-signing handshake. Who can join? @samantha?

samantha: I can join Thu 11:00 UTC. Also can someone capture the attestation transcript and upload to the evidence sheet. Link: https://docs.redwood.example/compliance/attestation-checklist

marta: Will capture logs and upload to S3. I'll set perms to security-only.

infra-bot: deploys: staging-batch-rotations triggered by infra at 1718511000. Status: running -> will post results.

kevin: CI red on keywrap unit test, fixing now. Expect a PR in ~20m.

jules: Vendor-bot sent attest-package; starting upload to s3://redwood-evidence/attestations/1718509999/ now.

marta: Export uploaded: s3://redwood-audit/samples/1718509999.tar.gz. Permissions: security-only. MD5: 9f2c3b4d.

samantha: Received — added link to evidence tracker sheet and to the SOC2 fieldwork checklist. If infra rotation + keystore smoke are green by EOD, we'll mark this milestone green. If not, we fallback to contingency window on Fri.

kevin: PR up: https://git.redwood.example/pkgs/keystore/pull/142, includes test fix and an integration test for key rotation flow.

infra: Rotation finished, smoke logs look clean. Uploading rotation proof file (rotation-proof-1718511200.json) to the evidence bucket now.

samantha: Great — thanks team. Next steps: Marta attach audit export to ticket INC-421, Jules confirm vendor attestation timestamp in calendar invite, Kevin watch for any post-merge failures, infra will rotate creds out after verification. :white_check_mark:

marta: Done — attached export to INC-421 and to the tracker.

jules: Calendar invite sent with vendor; added meeting notes template.

samantha: Closing the preflight thread. If anything new pops up, reply here and I'll escalate.

infra-bot: note: evidence-bundle created /evidence/bundles/1718509999.zip

vendor-bot: Attestation cert uploaded to S3 and mirrored to vendor-archive.

samantha: :rocket: Thanks all, we should be ready for fieldwork.
